column14: Rigorous reproduction of the masking process, notebooks/02_forecastability.ipynb. Key results: masking is bimodal per test month (6 fully-observed 0%, 12 blackout 99.58-99.97%, no gradient); every test month short of the full 15715-location grid as rows (38-195 absent, new finding); blackout unmasked-row overlap exhaustively checked across all 66 month-pairs (range 0-29, mean 1.53, 0 always-unmasked locations) -- refines prior '0-2 overlap' claim in COMPETITIVE_ANALYSIS.md and surfaces a weak same-calendar-month echo (Feb2016 vs Feb2017, overlap 29); preview cross-reference (sourced via web search, not yet formal Experiment 7) shows test-absent months Jul2017-Jun2018 closely match the documented GRACE-to-GRACE-FO hard gap (Jul2017-May2018). Docs updated: ASSUMPTIONS.md A-001 evidence strengthened (status kept Active, not Validated -- Experiment 7 still pending), COMPETITIVE_ANALYSIS.md Section 3 overlap claim corrected, DATA_DICTIONARY.md per-month grid completeness caveat added, PROJECT_PLAN.md Experiment 1 checkbox detail expanded.

Hard-gate investigation of the 2015 persistence-RMSE anomaly (0.898 vs 0.51-0.63 in 2002-2014), notebooks/02_forecastability.ipynb section 7-8. Ruled out partial-year/seasonal-composition artifact directly (pooled 2002-2014 Jan-Aug vs Sep-Dec persistence RMSE ratio only 1.03, far too small to explain the jump). Found the elevation is episodic within 2015 (Jan/Feb/Mar/Jun/Jul elevated 1.6-2.1x normal; Apr/May/Aug normal), broad-based not outlier-driven (1%-trimmed RMSE barely moves, median abs residual roughly doubles), global not regional (both hemispheres elevated similarly in worst month, Feb), and directional not just noisier (systematic negative mean-residual shift). Sourced cross-reference to the 2015-16 El Nino event (comparable in strength to 1997-98, documented global TWS/drought anomalies) offers a plausible physical explanation, not verified month-by-month against an ENSO index. VERDICT: genuine regime characteristic, not an artifact -- do not discard/down-weight 2015, but do not assume 2002-2014 volatility is representative of the Sep2015-Dec2018 test period either. Docs updated: ASSUMPTIONS.md A-004 upgraded Active-under-investigation to Validated (with caveat), new A-007 added for the El Nino hypothesis specifically (Active, pending ENSO-index verification), PROJECT_PLAN.md Experiment 2 checkbox marked complete with full findings.
